description: PTY-only terminal recovery (terminal-output-accounting §1; ruling 2026-11-15 03:5x). A retained non-PTY SFTP session uses the existing no-ring handshake, with no replayed frames, no seal_output or release_accounted and no code-9 marker. The final handshake discovers ended:true and uses legacy release. The earlier re-dials retain input gating/output resumption and first_buffered_seq=current_seq+1, including output sent into a dead peer. The existing SFTP loss rule remains; no loss rule is invented for exec, netconf or forward. Reference obligation only: this tag does not open non-PTY sessions.
